# NFSU2 Server control v1.8.2

## Fixed
- Retrying an interrupted setup now fetches the latest `origin/main` into the existing WSL checkout before compiling.
- Existing tracked edits and staged changes are never overwritten; divergent/local-only commits stop with an explicit error.
- Shallow checkouts are unshallowed before a fast-forward-only update, so retries cannot silently rebuild stale sources.
- The installer still preserves the existing game files, module and persistent Docker volumes.
